objective: Improve mobile readiness, performance and web/mobile state convergence without expanding product functionality.
requiredInvariants: Persisted query state is explicitly owned by one authenticated user on web and mobile.
Unknown or changed cache ownership purges persisted user-scoped state before the new session is adopted.
Logout clears query cache and user-scoped Zustand state on both surfaces.
Mobile logout/account switch disconnects the chat socket and clears pending payment recovery handoffs.
Mobile mounted screens reconcile with the backend even when hydrated cache data is still inside staleTime.
Financial mutations remain excluded from automatic background replay.
Legacy pre-Phase-46 persisted caches are invalidated by cache busters.
